name: solodit-extractor
description: Extract vulnerability data from Solodit API for AI security auditor training

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); ['../checkpoints', '../raw', '../logs'].forEach(d => { const dir = path.join(__dirname, d); if(fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.rmSync(dir, {recursive: true}); }); console.log('✅ Cleaned data directories');"
